summary: Produced Surface Brief with a seven-element information architecture, three-range responsive model, state matrix and accessibility contract. All four required outputs are in one document rather than four, since no template maps to them.

claims.claim: The phase declares four outputs (Surface Brief, Information Architecture, Responsive Model, State Matrix) and no template in framework/templates/run/ maps to three of them.
The surface has no data dependency, so it has no loading, empty or error states.

risks: The hard constraint 'real loading/empty/error states' from the CREATE genre does not apply to this surface; a gate that checked state coverage mechanically would need to accept that.
